sections.heading: Book an introduction
sections.text: Book a workshop introduction before using shared tools. Your first visit includes a tour and a safety briefing.

sections.heading: What to bring
sections.text: Bring comfortable clothes, closed shoes and your membership card. Ask a volunteer if you need support.

sections.heading: Choose a session
sections.text: Choose a workshop session from the weekly timetable. Book a place at least one day ahead.

sections.heading: Change a booking
sections.text: Change or cancel your booking before the session starts so another member can use the place.

sections.heading: Saw safety
sections.text: The workshop has hand saws, clamps and a supervised table saw. Complete the safety introduction before booking powered tools.

sections.heading: Change a blade
sections.text: Ask the supervisor before changing a blade. Unplug the saw and wait until all moving parts have stopped.

sections.heading: Thread the needle
sections.text: Use the workshop sewing machines to repair clothing or practise a pattern. Bring suitable fabric and thread.

sections.heading: Wind the bobbin
sections.text: A volunteer can help you wind the bobbin and adjust the stitch length. Keep spare thread beside the sewing machine.

sections.heading: Step-free access
sections.text: The workshop entrance and main tables have step-free access. Contact the team if you need a different table height.

sections.heading: Quieter sessions
sections.text: Quieter workshop sessions run on Tuesday mornings. Tell the team before your visit if you need a support person.

sections.heading: Arrive by bus or bicycle
sections.text: Find the workshop beside the community library. The nearest bus stop is Market Street and bicycle parking is outside.

sections.heading: The courtyard gate
sections.text: The courtyard gate closes at eight in the evening. Leave enough time to collect your belongings before closing.
